orgs.name: Tavus
orgs.description: Conversational video AI company whose model line runs from offline replica videos (Phoenix, 2024) through the real-time Conversational Video Interface and the Phoenix, Raven and Sparrow models to Griffin (2026), a full-duplex video-to-video model in research preview; it also sells consumer AI companions (PALs).
orgs.description_zh: 对话视频 AI 公司，其模型序列从离线复刻视频（Phoenix，2024）经过实时对话视频接口和 Phoenix、Raven、Sparrow 系列模型，发展到处于研究预览阶段的全双工视频到视频模型 Griffin（2026）；它也面向个人用户提供 AI 伙伴 PALs。

orgs.name: HeyGen
orgs.description: AI avatar video company known for photo-to-video avatars and video translation; its LiveAvatar API streams real-time avatars for voice agents and plugs into LiveKit and Pipecat.
orgs.description_zh: 以照片生成虚拟人视频和视频翻译著称的 AI 虚拟人视频公司；其 LiveAvatar API 为语音智能体实时推流虚拟人，并可接入 LiveKit 和 Pipecat。

orgs.name: Synthesia
orgs.description: Enterprise AI video company whose avatars present training and communication videos; in 2026 it added Sessions, real-time avatar roleplays and spoken surveys with AI feedback, and an interactive avatars API.
orgs.description_zh: 企业级 AI 视频公司，其虚拟人主讲培训和沟通视频；2026 年推出 Sessions（带 AI 反馈的实时虚拟人角色扮演和语音问卷）以及交互式虚拟人 API。

orgs.name: Anam
orgs.description: London company building real-time avatar diffusion models (Cara-3, Cara-4, Cara-4.1 Express) for conversational agents; it also publishes a cross-vendor latency and rating benchmark of avatar APIs, run by itself.
orgs.description_zh: 位于伦敦、为对话智能体开发实时虚拟人扩散模型（Cara-3、Cara-4、Cara-4.1 Express）的公司；它也发布由自己执行的、跨厂商的虚拟人 API 延迟与评分基准。

orgs.name: D-ID
orgs.description: Israeli talking-head company, known publicly for animating old photos, that now sells real-time conversational avatars (V4 Expressive Visual Agents, 2026) through an API, a LiveKit plug-in and self-hosting.
orgs.description_zh: 以让老照片动起来而为公众所知的以色列说话人头公司，如今通过 API、LiveKit 插件和私有部署出售实时对话虚拟人（V4 Expressive Visual Agents，2026）。

orgs.name: Simli
orgs.description: Real-time avatar API built as a face layer for voice agents, with Gaussian-splat avatars (Trinity-1) priced from under one cent per minute, the lowest published rate among avatar providers in 2026.
orgs.description_zh: 作为语音智能体“脸部层”的实时虚拟人 API，采用高斯泼溅虚拟人（Trinity-1），每分钟价格低于 1 美分，是 2026 年虚拟人服务中公开报价最低的。

orgs.name: Beyond Presence
orgs.description: Munich company whose Genesis real-time avatar models give existing voice agents a face (speech-to-video) or run as managed video agents for sales, HR, coaching and tutoring.
orgs.description_zh: 位于慕尼黑的公司，其 Genesis 实时虚拟人模型为现有语音智能体提供“脸”（语音转视频），也可作为销售、招聘、辅导和教学的托管视频智能体运行。

orgs.name: Silicon Intelligence (Duix)
orgs.description: Chinese digital-human company behind the Duix platform for live commerce and customer service; it open-sources Duix-Avatar (offline video cloning, formerly HeyGem) and Duix Mobile, which runs interactive digital humans on phones and kiosks without a cloud server.
orgs.description_zh: 中国数字人公司，打造面向直播带货和客服的 Duix 平台；它开源了 Duix-Avatar（离线视频克隆，前身为 HeyGem）和 Duix Mobile，后者无需云服务器即可在手机和终端机上运行交互式数字人。
